title: Patterns and reasoning

lessons.objective: Find the repeating unit before predicting the next item.
Check a proposed number rule against every step.
Distinguish turning a shape from reflecting it.
Sort objects by two rules at once.
Identify what must follow from the stated facts.
Read separate Venn-diagram regions and avoid double counting shared members.

description: Six short lessons in spotting patterns, testing rules and making careful deductions. Finish with a pizza-order puzzle that makes overlapping groups clear.
introduction:
A repeating pattern, a paper shape and a pizza order can all hide a small puzzle. Learn to notice the rule, check it and explain what follows.

Read each short lesson at your own pace. The quizzes are optional, and you can return to any chapter.
prerequisites: Basic counting. No previous logic lessons needed.
